resources.string: You do not have to sit with this alone
What you wrote sounds like more than a hard day. If you are thinking about hurting yourself, talking to someone now matters more than anything in this app.
If you are in immediate danger, call 112. A person you trust is enough; you do not have to explain everything.
That sounds like a lot to carry
What you wrote sounds heavier than an ordinary hard day. Talking to someone now can help, and nothing in this app replaces a person.
